cards.card_text: The Reubenites and the Gadites, two of Israel's tribes, take a good long look at the lands of Jazer and Gilead.
cards.verse_text: Now the Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, surveyed the lands of Jazer and Gilead, and they saw that the region was suitable for livestock.

cards.card_text: Moses loves the plan from the Gadites and Reubenites and says yes right away.
cards.verse_text: But Moses asked the Gadites and Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
cards.snippet: But Moses asked the Gadites and Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

cards.card_text: Moses ends with, "you will be the cause of their destruction." Then the Gadites and Reubenites come back with a new pitch: sheepfolds here for their livestock and cities for their little ones, and friend, I'm LISTENING.
cards.verse_text: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.” Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said, “We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.

cards.card_text: How do the Gadites and Reubenites answer?
cards.verse_text: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “Your servants will do just as our lord commands.
cards.snippet: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “Your servants will do just as our lord commands.

cards.card_text: So Moses gives orders to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the family leaders of the tribes: if the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan armed for battle and the land is subdued, they are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
cards.verse_text: And Moses said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, with every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession.

cards.verse_text: The Gadites and Reubenites replied, “As the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.

cards.card_text: Moses gives land east of the Jordan to the Gadites, the Reubenites and the half-tribe of ___.
cards.verse_text: So Moses gave to the Gadites, to the Reubenites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the land including its cities and the territory surrounding them.

cards.card_text: That half-tribe comes from Manasseh son of Joseph, and Moses gives the Gadites, the Reubenites and that half-tribe the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, with their cities and the territory around them.

cards.verse_text: The Reubenites built up Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim, as well as Nebo and Baal-meon (whose names were changed), and Sibmah.

cards.card_text: That's the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
cards.verse_text: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
cards.snippet: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

cards.card_text: Now meet the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, the tribes whose land is back on the east side of the Jordan (Joshua 1:12-15).
cards.verse_text: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over before the Israelites, armed for battle as Moses had instructed them.

cards.card_text: Joshua, Israel's leader, calls in the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and he tells them, “You have done all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and you have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you.”

cards.card_text: Then comes Reuben's family line, down to Beerah, a Reubenite leader whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carries into exile.
cards.verse_text: Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.
cards.snippet: Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.

cards.card_text: Jerijah's relatives come to 2,700 capable men, all heads of families, and King David puts them over the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
cards.verse_text: King David appointed them over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
